page.notes: Left margin notes are interleaved with the text and their placement is approximate. The Greek margin notes "1" and "2" are doubtful. The margin note "i Apolog.2. in eodem loco ... ex vitio sa unius" is badly printed. Its readings are uncertain, and it is partly cut off at the edge. The mark letters in the text and the foot notes are hard to match with certainty, especially from k to b. "Lactati" and "Eufebi" were read as Lactantius and Eusebius, but the printed forms may differ. The foot block is printed in small type and some words are doubtful.
